topic: consolidating Docker image builds into a single docker-bake HCL file - multi-target bake definitions as the single source of truth for image variants and their CI wiring

subtopics.scope: The Bake HCL file model itself: targets, groups, inheritance (inherits), variables and user-defined functions, and how a single committed file becomes the single source of truth for all image variants.
seed_queries: docker bake HCL file targets groups inheritance reference
docker bake HCL variables user-defined functions build args

subtopics.scope: target.contexts and target:<name> named build contexts: how a bake target consumes another target as a build context, e.g. a dev Containerfile consuming the internal production image target instead of a local tag workaround.
seed_queries: docker bake target contexts target name build context
docker bake additional contexts compose files named contexts

subtopics.scope: Docker Build Policies inside bake: the target.policy attribute (filename, reset, strict), fail-closed OPA/Rego contracts applied to every exported target, and inheritance of a shared _policy target.
seed_queries: docker buildx bake policy attribute rego build policy
docker build policy reset strict OPA rego buildx

subtopics.scope: Bake target outputs: registry exporter vs docker/oci exporters as per-target output properties, letting one target emit local Docker output for CI and registry output for publish runs.
seed_queries: docker bake registry exporter docker exporter output
docker buildx exporters types image oci docker registry

subtopics.scope: Builder selection mechanics: buildx create --use writes the active builder into the invoking Docker configuration, while bake --builder overrides it; user-scoped named builders (e.g. hardened) created in the same Docker configuration that invokes bake.
seed_queries: docker buildx create --use builder selection docker config

subtopics.scope: Privileged build entitlements: explicit --allow daemon and invocation grants, RUN --device needing labs syntax and CDI-registered devices, and why /dev/kvm lanes stay host-workflow responsibilities.
seed_queries: docker build entitlement privileged buildx allow
dockerfile RUN --device CDI labs syntax buildx

subtopics.scope: The bake/Actions responsibility split: which orchestrated lanes map to which bake targets or groups, what stays in GitHub Actions (runner selection, imagetools index assembly, source mutation, artifact transfer, mkosi, bcvk/Podman, KVM), and bake's limits as a model.
seed_queries: docker bake github actions ci single file consolidation
docker bake what it does not model github actions responsibilities

subtopics.scope: Static validation before CI: resolving targets with bake --print, rendering local and PUSH variants per architecture, checking tag invariants, inheritance output shapes, and workflow YAML reconciliation.
seed_queries: docker buildx bake --print resolve check without building
docker bake validate targets tags static validation ci
